name: flipcountdown
blurb: Animated countdown timer displaying days, hours, minutes, seconds with flip effect.
description: Client component counting down to a hardcoded target date (Dec 31, 2026). Updates every second and stops at zero. Each time unit (days, hours, minutes, seconds) renders in a colored box with a horizontal divider line. Uses CSS animations for flip transitions.
use_when: Event countdowns (product launches, sales, deadlines) where a dramatic, eye-catching timer is needed.
avoid_when: Customizable countdown targets needed; target date is hardcoded and requires component modification to change.
a11y: Displays time numerically but no aria-live updates. No keyboard interaction. Announces countdown statically only.
